title: Universal covering of a connected free category and its hammock lifts
statement:
Use small simplicial categories and weak homotopy equivalences as in [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], and the reduced-hammock construction $H(C,U)$ of [lem-coef-hammock-graph-colimit-presentation]. Let $C$ be a small free category on a directed generating graph, and assume the underlying undirected graph is nonempty and connected. There is a covering functor $q:\widetilde C\to C$, surjective on objects, with $\widetilde C$ free on an oriented tree (a nonempty graph with a unique finite undirected simple path between any two vertices), such that $N\widetilde C$ is contractible. It is the category obtained by lifting each generating edge, with its orientation, to the universal covering tree of the generating graph. For $x,y\in C$ and a chosen $\widetilde x$ above $x$, unique lifting of hammock rectangles induces an isomorphism of simplicial sets
$$\coprod_{\widetilde y\in q^{-1}(y)} H(\widetilde C,\widetilde C)(\widetilde x,\widetilde y)\ \cong\ H(C,C)(x,y).$$
The functor is a map of pairs $(\widetilde C,\widetilde C)\to(C,C)$; no complementary free factor is retained and no single connected cover of a disconnected category is asserted.
